title: 967. String Without AAA or BBB

examples.explanation: One valid arrangement is abb; it uses one a and two b's with no triple.
aabaa uses four a's and one b while avoiding aaa and bbb.

hints: Always try to emit the currently more plentiful letter, unless doing so would create three in a row.
When the last two emitted letters are equal, you are forced to emit the other letter next.
This greedy choice keeps the construction feasible whenever max(a,b) <= 2*(min(a,b)+1).
